description: Returns the developer's profile: public name (a studio or company name, shown as the author of their apps and in the gallery; the email is never shown), dashboard language, whether API keys are saved, the emails on the account, and their studio: the public page of all their published apps, play.neblla.com/studio/<studioSlug> (`studio`: slug, url, about, web, links). Without a short name yet, `studio.slug` shows the one Neblla would propose (`proposed: true`) and nothing is stored. Changes are made with neblla_developer_profile_update.
name: neblla_developer_profile
title: Developer profile
